ios.notes:
Poster: a photo of the artist fills Now Playing, a different one for each song.
Black and white with grain, or in colour, fading into the photo's own colour at the top and bottom.
Pick it in Customise, or the new Poster theme does it all in one tap.
Controls, in Customise: keep the heart and the play ring white, with the colour only in the background.

Duotone for iPhone 6.1.1

New
- Poster, in Customise → Artwork: a photo of the artist behind the top, the title and the controls. Each song gets its own photo while the artist has photos; without them, the artwork. The lyrics still turn in the square.
- Poster image: artist photos or the artwork. Black and white: the Poster with grain, like a printed photo.
- The Poster theme: artist photos in black and white, "Playing from", the ring play button and white controls in one tap.
- Controls, in Customise → Now Playing: Accent colour or White for the heart, the play ring, the dots, shuffle and repeat.

Improved
- The preview in Customise shows the progress bar in white, as in Now Playing.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.1.0...ios-v6.1.1

windows.notes:
Duotone shows up as Duotone in the Windows volume mixer again.
It also remembers where you left its window.

Duotone for Windows 7.0.1

Fixed
- The Windows volume mixer shows Duotone, with its icon, instead of "Microsoft Edge WebView2".
- Duotone opens at the size and in the place you left it, and maximized if it was.
- Uses less processor while music plays: the little playing bars no longer keep the screen redrawing all the time.

Minimum version: 7.0.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.0.0...win-v7.0.1

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
